units: Midd. IV, 7 מה ארי צר … ור׳ מלפניו וכ׳ (not ורוחב) as the lion’s body is narrow behind and wide in front, so was the Temple &c.; a. fr.—נפש ר׳ (wide desire,) ambition, greed, opp. שפלה.

<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:19">Ab. V, 19</cite>; a. e.—<he>יד ר׳</he>, v. <cite ref="J00093"><he>יָד</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>רְחָבִים</he>, <he>רְחָבִין</he>; <he>רְחָבוֹת</he>. Tanḥ. B’haʿăl. 5 <he>שהיו ר׳ מבחוץ וכ׳</he> they (the Temple windows) were wide without &c., v. <cite ref="T00474">preced.</cite>; Tanḥ. T’tsav. 6; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 15:7">Num. R. s. 15</cite>, beg.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 9:6:3">Y. Sot. IX, 24ᵃ</cite> bot., v. <cite ref="R00727"><he>צַר</he></cite>; a. fr.
